findings.title: M4 mandatory journeys require physical receipts while the first printer capability was owned by M5a.
findings.finding: M4 mandatory journeys require physical receipts while the first printer capability was owned by M5a.
findings.verification: M4 has a minimum real physical-receipt path; M5a separately owns durable queue, retry, restart recovery, deduplication, health, outage continuity and reconciliation.
findings.residual_risk: None; v2.0.5 Codex verified M4/M5a print separation.

findings.title: Decision D-113 provenance differed between narrative and machine-readable sources.
findings.finding: Decision D-113 provenance differed between narrative and machine-readable sources.
findings.verification: Canonical decision source is v2.0.3 in the reconciled decision catalog.

findings.title: Original package assessment counts were stale.
findings.finding: Original package assessment counts were stale.
findings.verification: The v2.0.6 generator publishes current row-level counts and all projections from canonical records.

findings.title: Row-level 500 original requirement and 100 original decision dispositions were missing.
findings.finding: Row-level 500 original requirement and 100 original decision dispositions were missing.
findings.verification: The frozen canonical baseline contains the 500/100 row-level evidence; this package retains the exact source hashes and maps all 294 active originals.

findings.title: The dependency graph was generic and milestone-wide rather than requirement-specific.
findings.finding: The dependency graph was generic and milestone-wide rather than requirement-specific.
findings.verification: Two independent clause-level reviews were reconciled and the final graph has requirement-specific gates, prerequisites, journeys and tests.
findings.residual_risk: Codex remains the independent semantic reviewer.

findings.title: The package validator relied on PyYAML and checked structure rather than full semantics.
findings.finding: The package validator relied on PyYAML and checked structure rather than full semantics.
findings.verification: The standard-library validator was frozen and challenged through two blind mutation rounds; final limitations are disclosed.
findings.residual_risk: Post-repair diagnostics are not fresh blind evidence.

findings.title: GJ-01A said outlet authority persists at M3, implying local authority before M5b.
findings.finding: GJ-01A said outlet authority persists at M3, implying local authority before M5b.
findings.verification: GJ-01A now states that the current approved cloud authority persists and makes no local-authority claim before M5b.

findings.title: Private-key custody was inconsistent.
findings.finding: Private-key custody was inconsistent.
findings.verification: The node generates and retains the private key, submits only a CSR, receives only the certificate chain, and never exports the private key.
findings.residual_risk: Operational HSM/keystore choice remains an implementation decision under this contract.

findings.title: FR-EDG-028 test ID used inconsistent M5b casing.
findings.finding: FR-EDG-028 test ID used inconsistent M5b casing.
findings.verification: Engineering test ID is normalized to TST-M5b-FR-EDG-028.

findings.title: Amendment and finding logs were not exact enough.
findings.finding: Amendment and finding logs were not exact enough.
findings.verification: Each prior finding has an ID, severity, disposition, affected IDs, verification and residual risk.
findings.residual_risk: Future findings must use the same structure.

findings.title: Journey links were not consistently aligned to introduction/revalidation gates
findings.finding: Journey links were not consistently aligned to introduction/revalidation gates
findings.verification: Every journey milestone now equals the requirement introducing gate or a declared revalidation gate.

findings.title: Round 2 exposed five validator coverage gaps
findings.finding: Round 2 exposed five validator coverage gaps
findings.verification: All five disclosed Round 2 misses are detected after repair. No Round 3 is required under the agreed two-round cap unless Codex later identifies a P0 validator defect.
findings.residual_risk: The post-repair rerun is diagnostic rather than fresh independent evidence. This limitation is disclosed to Codex.

findings.title: M5a service boundary contradiction
findings.finding: m5_ownership.json listed local_backup_agent although FR-EDG-002A requires exactly five services.
findings.verification: M5a now lists exactly five services; backup scheduling and restore remain M6.

findings.title: Stale canonical governance state
findings.finding: Residual/finding records described validator and blind rounds as future work.
findings.verification: Lifecycle state is current and projections are regenerated.

findings.title: Non-uniform clause schema
findings.finding: Ten clauses omitted exact_clause_text and used substitute fields.
findings.verification: All 337 clauses share one enforced contract.

findings.title: Projection content loss
findings.finding: Amendments, findings, split reasons and non-regression rules were incompletely published.
findings.verification: All canonical fields and all 96 rules are projected and field-compared.

findings.title: Forbidden-surface rules not executable
findings.finding: Validator did not load the normative vocabulary and sense exclusions.
findings.verification: Validator executes the normative rule file and planted tests cover every domain and permitted sense.

findings.title: Decision provenance and stale reuse evidence
findings.finding: D-100 lacked amendment evidence and D-102 named v2.0.4 tests.
findings.verification: D-100 amendment is explicit and D-102 requires exact pinned-package tests.

findings.title: Divergent test-ID namespaces
findings.finding: Top-level and clause-level test IDs diverged on 18 requirements.
findings.verification: One canonical test-ID policy is enforced across all projections.

findings.title: Required outer artifact pin was not delivered
findings.finding: The Package M0 review received the ZIP without the separately supplied .zip.sha256 publisher pin.
findings.verification: The v2.0.8 ZIP and matching sidecar are delivered together and the prompt states the expected digest.
findings.residual_risk: External delivery must include both files.

findings.title: Forbidden-surface validator admitted coherent deferred-domain obligations
findings.finding: Sentence-wide negation and requirement-wide sense allowances could permit unrelated positive payroll, inventory or variance obligations.
findings.verification: Occurrence-linked parser rejects all four Codex examples and targeted variants while preserving approved senses.
findings.residual_risk: Human semantic review remains required for novel wording.

findings.title: D-100 referred to nonexistent YAML projections
findings.finding: The package uses JSON as its controlled machine-readable projection, not YAML.
findings.verification: All decision projections use the corrected JSON wording.
